permitted_change.boundary: Only nine private value-core definitions, their exact declarations in three raw modules, and direct core calls
permitted_change.old: InaccessibleModRef | OtherRef; six math definitions already InaccessibleModRef
permitted_change.new: InaccessibleModRef; every ordinary location remains NoModRef

local_pointer_proof: The nine value cores accept only integer vectors and an integer mask, and return only integer-vector aggregates. No caller pointer, external address or pointer-valued result crosses that boundary.

cloneMath replaces original bank/tag pointer arguments by new local allocas, initializes them from value arguments and zero private D, and fixes all indices. The exact input pins and full-module fingerprints bind this derivation.

The only two pointer reloads are fast_term lambda captures at math.ll604/608. Its source captures only local x and by-value Triple a. All30 pointer stores initialize those local closure objects (6 tagged-add,6 tagged-subtract,18 tagged-multiply); loaded pointees are those local F/Triple allocations.

Internal slow helpers receive only local byval copies and local sret destinations. Lambda sret destinations are likewise core-local. Internal helper pointers do not escape to globals, returned values, callbacks or other opaque users.

All ordinary loads/stores and memcpy/memset/lifetime accesses are therefore rooted in core-owned or internally copied local storage. Personality is only a declaration/reference; nounwind bodies contain no invoke or exception path.

Constrained FP and noalias-scope intrinsics keep their full inaccessible-memory effects. This proves absence of ordinary memory access at the outer value boundary for all input bitpatterns; no finite-value, canonical-metadata or ignored-exception assumption is needed.

pass_review.guard: Math permits exactly InaccessibleRW or InaccessibleRW|OtherRef; raw core declarations and direct calls require exactly the conservative latter. Equality checks reject effects at every other location.
pass_review.pointer_inventory: 12defs/2pointerloads/30pointerstores/no dynamic GEP or new channel checked against separately loaded pinned math in every mode
pass_review.mutation: Only private names and nine-core/direct-call memory summaries; full forward/inverse module fingerprint and verifier checks retain everything else

finite_FP_obligation.note: Fast_product does not clear every inactive operand, so active-domain bounds alone cannot prove all physical arithmetic finite. This artifact authorizes no FP-model or NaN-behavior change.
